in_marathi.name: Gulab
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sweet like Jaggery
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gulab हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gulab is derived from the Sanskrit word 'gul' meaning jaggery or sweet. It is often used as a term of endearment and is a popular name for baby girls in Hindu culture.
